about_history_p1: Instalaciones de Sistemas de Alarma S.A (INSA), founded in April 1983, with extensive experience spanning over 35 years in residential and business security.
about_history_p2: The project that started in the basics of alarms with great enthusiasm has evolved constantly thanks to new technologies into CCTV, IP cameras, sophisticated anti-intrusion means, fire detection, video analysis, etc.
about_history_p3: After-sales service is a distinguishing quality of ours, as we service all brands in the sector, providing continuous consulting to all our clients.
about_philosophy_p1: We offer Security, Peace of Mind, and Control. Our technical team and human personnel provide the personalized treatment that sets us apart from other companies. We understand our clients' needs and advise them on the best options.
about_philosophy_p2: We use equipment from the best brands on the market, with an optimal price-quality ratio.
about_future_p1: Beyond personal service to our clients, we quickly address and resolve any issues from other brands (due to poor after-sales service or dissatisfaction with prior installations), aiming to become your security consultants and make you our Clients and Friends.
